{{Top|leg}}
The '''Mestani sector''' was a sector in [[the galaxy]] established at some point before the [[war against Zakuul]] in [[3630 BBY]]. During that year, [[Theron Shan]] of the [[Eternal Alliance|Anti-Zakuul Alliance]] visited the sector while securing military allies for the fight against the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]].<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=14}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mestani sector is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter 14: Mandalore the Avenger'''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
